changes.summary: Export one explicit snapshot as an offline bundle under the server-owned state/exports directory. The caller supplies a safe output_name. Source and raw-trace bytes are included only with explicit include_source/include_raw_traces opt-in and the manifest then marks the bundle sensitive.

report_bundle.manifest: manifest.json with per-file sha256/size/media_type/kind, optional source_path/owners, source_state, raw_trace_state, risk_level and bundle_digest
report_bundle.secrets_included: no source or trace bytes, or 'unknown: no secret scanner ran'
report_bundle.risk_labels: present when source or trace bytes are included; the HTML banner says the bundle is sensitive
report_bundle.bounded_graph: omissions are explicit with counts and reasons

viewer.interaction: anchor links to entity detail cards and CSS :target highlighting

ledger_migration.target: must not exist; an existing or populated target is refused
verification: source and target sqlite integrity_check = ok
schema versions and all table row counts match
every CAS object is rehashed on read and after write
every artifacts.digest is present in the copied CAS
ledger_migration.failure: the partial target directory is removed

preconditions: every referenced CAS object exists and hashes correctly
promotion.transaction: session marked promoted, project mode changed, manager session created
promotion.failure: no mode change; source session and records remain readable
